name: Tougasaki Yuno
source:
A quiet hard worker who takes theater seriously.

A second-year student in the performing arts department at Minomori Private Academy.
Since her stage debut at a young age, she has been appearing consistently.

She is not well known among the general public because she rarely appears on television or other media, but she is well known among theater lovers and has a core fan base.

Her father runs a small-to-medium-sized entertainment production company, to which Yuino belongs.

Perhaps because she is surrounded by many adults, she tends to be seen as calmer than children her age and is often mistaken for an older person.
She is friendly and can talk normally with almost anyone, but she has a habit of keeping a step back, and has few friends who are more than a certain level close to her.
Among her few friends, Ikumi is a special person to whom she can show her true self. 

She is quite nosy with those she becomes close to, and is concerned about Ikumi's personal affairs.
One of her hobbies is coordinating Ikumi's outfits.
